channel.title: Paste Media Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: We'll have to wait a little longer to see if DC's Clayface will live up to that "body horror" label
item.description: James Watkin's Clayface movie has now been bumped back on the Warner Bros. schedule, to October 23, 2026.

item.title: Masters Of The Universe director declares Jared Leto's Skeletor "the embodiment of toxic masculinity”
item.description: "Jared approached us, because he loves Skeletor and has his own history with the character."

item.title: David Mamet's finally making his film version of film satire Speed-The-Plow
item.description: Anthony Mackie, Ben Mendelsohn, Sharon Stone, and Emily Alyn Lind will star in the film version of Mamet's Tony-winning Hollywood satire.

item.title: The History Of Concrete is the best episode of How To With John Wilson that never was
item.description: Those looking for more of the same from HBO's bone-dry documentarian will find exactly that in The History Of Concrete.

item.title: The fictions around Donuts reaffirm J Dilla’s legend
item.description: Time Capsule: Listening to Dilla’s masterpiece 20 years later confirms its timelessness: in his experiments with tempo, in its decade-spanning samples, in its aural hall of mirrors, in its enduring impact on music writ large.

item.title: R.I.P. Fred Smith: Television bassist dead at 77
item.description: According to Television's social media pages, bassist Fred Smith “fought his illness long and hard these last few years.”

item.title: Billie Joe Armstrong offers ICE agents career advice at pre-Super Bowl party: "Quit that shitty job"
item.description: Green Day is scheduled to play at the Super Bowl opening ceremony this year, ahead of Bad Bunny's halftime show performance.

item.title: R.I.P. Brad Arnold, lead singer of 3 Doors Down
item.description: Arnold spent more than 20 years as the band's frontman—notably writing its breakout hit "Kryptonite" in math class while still a teen.

item.title: What if they held a Kid Rock country music festival and no one came?
item.description: One leg of Rock's Rock The Country festival has been canceled amidst news that he's lost the critical Shinedown vote.
